title: Privacy Policy — Vote-Scope
description: Vote-Scope's privacy policy — no user accounts, no advertising profiles built by us, no data sold. Plain language on what is collected, the tools and partners involved, and how to refuse third-party tracking.
intro: VoteScope (vote-scope.com) is an electoral and sports intelligence site with no user accounts and no signup form. This page explains, in plain language, what is collected, the tools and partners that may be involved, and the choices you have. Last updated June 2026.
callout: In short: we do not sell your personal data and we do not build our own advertising profiles. We use privacy-respecting measurement tools to run the site, and some third-party features or future partners may set their own cookies or trackers — you can refuse those at any time without losing access to anything we offer.

sections.title: What is collected automatically
sections.bodyHtml: Like any website, our hosting and content-delivery providers may log standard technical data — such as an abbreviated or anonymized IP address, browser and device type, referring page, pages visited, and timestamps. This information is used to deliver the site, measure overall audience, ensure security, and detect technical problems. We do not use it to identify you personally.

sections.title: Measurement and search tools we use
sections.bodyHtml: We use a small set of tools to operate and improve the site, including search-performance tools such as Google Search Console (which reports how our pages appear in search results using aggregated, non-identifying data) and may use privacy-focused, cookie-free analytics. We do not personally deploy advertising cookies or cross-site tracking to profile you. If we add or change a measurement tool, we will update this page.

sections.title: Third-party partners, embeds and advertising
sections.bodyHtml:
Some features rely on independent third parties — for example embedded prediction-market widgets, newsletter or video embeds, content-delivery networks, and, in the future, possible advertising or sponsorship partners. These partners may set their own cookies, pixels, or similar technologies that are outside our control and governed by their own privacy policies.

You can refuse third-party cookies and trackers at any time — through your browser settings, a consent banner where one is presented, your device's privacy controls, or industry opt-out tools (for example the DAA, Your Online Choices, or your platform's ad-settings page). Refusing them does not reduce or change the experience we offer you — all VoteScope projections, indices, and analysis remain fully available.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.bodyHtml: We keep our own use of cookies to a minimum. Your language choice (EN/FR/ES) and similar preferences are stored in your browser's localStorage; that preference stays on your device and is accessible only to you. Any cookies set by the third parties described above belong to those parties and can be managed or cleared through your browser.

sections.title: Embedded third-party content
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope may embed or link to third-party services such as Polymarket (prediction markets), Substack (newsletters), and public data providers. When you interact with embedded content, that service may receive data about your visit under its own policy. Please review those policies directly.

sections.title: Election and sports data
sections.bodyHtml: Our projections and indices are built from public polling and official data (for example Elections Canada, Élections Québec, the Bank of Canada, the U.S. Federal Reserve / FRED, MIT Election Lab, and polling firms). No personal data about site visitors is involved in producing them.

sections.title: International visitors and your rights
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope is operated from Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, and information may be processed there or in other countries by our providers. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data, or to object to certain processing. To exercise any such right, contact us using the details below.

sections.title: Children
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope is intended for a general, adult audience interested in elections and sports analysis. It is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.bodyHtml: We may update this policy as the site evolves — including if we add advertising, sponsorships, or new partners. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated date. Questions about privacy: Kim Leclerc.
